Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer residential cleaning?

Yes. Residential cleaning includes general house cleaning, dusting and sanitizing, kitchen and bathroom cleaning, floors and vacuuming, and trash removal.

Do you clean offices and commercial spaces?

Yes. We offer office and retail space cleaning, detailed cleaning, floor care, and sanitizing.

Do you offer deep cleaning?

Yes. Deep cleaning and first cleans cover deep scrubbing, baseboards, interior windows, appliances, cabinets, and all rooms.

Do you offer move-in and move-out cleaning?

Yes. We remove dust and dirt, clean the fridge and oven, and clean bathrooms and kitchens so your space is ready for the next chapter.

How often can I schedule cleaning?

Weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly. One-time and deep cleaning are also available.

Do you offer add-on services?

Yes. Add-ons include fridge, oven, window, and patio or balcony cleaning, dishes, linen changing, and laundry. See the Extra Services prices above. Other extras are available upon request.

Are you open 24 hours?

Yes, Yenneka Cleaning Services is open 24 hours.

How do I request a quote?

Fill out the quote form or call 204-951-8258.
